## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A fourteen-fascicle (14卷) **doctrinal commentary** on the *Mahāvairocana-sūtra* / *Pílúzhēnà chéngfó shénbiàn jiāchí jīng* 毗盧遮那成佛神變加持經 ([KR6j0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0001) / T18 no. 848) by **Yīxíng** 一行 [一行](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%80%E8%A1%8C) (683–727), the Tang-dynasty polymath monk who served as the principal Chinese amanuensis-disciple of **Śubhakarasiṃha** (Shànwúwèi 善無畏 [善無畏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%84%A1%E7%95%8F)) on the *Mahāvairocana* translation. Preserved as **X23 no. 438** in the *Xùzàngjīng*. The *Yìshì* is the **fourteen-fascicle revised recension** of Yīxíng's earlier and longer *Dàrìjīng shū* 大日經疏 ([KR6j0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0080) / T39 no. 1796), prepared after Yīxíng's death by his disciple **Wēngǔ** 溫古 [溫古](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BA%AB%E5%8F%A4) (a co-disciple of Yīxíng under Śubhakarasiṃha).

**Abstract**

The *Yìshì* is the **principal Esoteric-school doctrinal commentary** on the *Mahāvairocana-sūtra* in East Asia: along with its earlier twenty-fascicle counterpart ([KR6j0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0080)), it transmits Śubhakarasiṃha's oral teachings on the *Mahāvairocana* and provides the doctrinal foundation for both Chinese **Mìzōng** 密宗 / 真言宗 and the Japanese **Shingon** 真言宗 traditions. The *Garbhadhātu* (*Tāizàng* 胎藏) maṇḍala doctrines that Śubhakarasiṃha transmitted are explicated here in their canonical form. The relationship between the longer *Dàrìjīng shū* (T39n1796) and the shorter *Dàrì jīng yìshì* (X23n0438) — both attributed to Yīxíng with Wēngǔ's editorial role — has been the subject of extensive scholarly investigation; the consensus is that the *Yìshì* is Wēngǔ's posthumous abridgment-and-revision of Yīxíng's lecture-notes. Composition: 720s, before Yīxíng's death in 727; Wēngǔ's editorial work likely shortly thereafter.
